NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
4100-08 West Belmont Avenue/ 3200-10 North Karlov Avenue
From M1-1 to B2-3

The property is located on the northwest corner of West Belmont Avenue and North Karlovy Avenue in an
Mt-1 zoning district. The property is located in a Transit Served Location and is approximately 20.0 feet
from the Belmont Bus (Route 77) corridor. The site is improved with a one story commercial building.

The Project

BELMONT KARLOV LLC (the “Applicant”) proposes to construct a new five-story building (57’-2” height)
with approximately 2,000 square feet of commercial space, 32 residential units, 22 parking spaces, and 32
bicycle spaces. The residential units will be accessed from West Karlov Avenue.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks to rezone the property from an MI1-1, Limited
Manufacturing/Business Park District to a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

As partofthe rezoning, the Applicant seeks a Type-1 rezoning application for optional variationrelief under
section 1 7-13-0300(D)and all reliefas needed andas allowedby the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached
plans. The optional variation sought is as follows: 1) per 17-13-1101-B to reducethe rear yard setback from
30.0 feet to 6.0 feet; 2) per section 17-13-1101-D to reduce one loading berth under section | 7-10-1101;
and 3) per section 17-13-1003-X to reduce the ground-floor commercial floor area requirement of section
17-3-0305 by up to 20%.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 12,408.08 square feet

Floor Area: 46,500 square feet

Maximum FAR: 4.00

Residential Dwelling Units: 32

MLA Density: 387.8

Height: 57-2”

Bicycle Parking: 32

Automobile Parking: 22*

Setbacks: East (Karlov Avenue): 12”
North (Alley): 5.0”
South (Belmont Avenue): 12”
West (rear yard setback): 6.0°*

A set of plans is attached.
* As indicated above, the Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 1 7-13-0303-D.
